personal_information.headline: Full-Stack .NET & Angular | Performance-Focused, Scalable Product Development

summary: I design and deliver clean, scalable software with a strong focus on production stability and long-term maintainability. Senior Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building systems used by global customers. Currently at Brain Station 23, working with .NET Core, Angular, TypeScript, and SQL Server. Strong in backend architecture, API design, and taking features from concept to production. Certified nopCommerce developer with hands-on experience in eCommerce and ERP platforms. Focused on writing readable, testable code that performs well under real-world load. Regularly collaborate with distributed teams across time zones. Comfortable working in remote-first, async environments with international stakeholders.

body: I highly recommend Sanjit as an exceptional full-stack developer and team member. Throughout our time working together, Sanjit has consistently demonstrated remarkable passion and dedication to delivering high-quality solutions.

What sets Sanjit apart is his unique combination of technical expertise and outstanding client communication skills. He has a natural ability to understand complex requirements, translate them into effective technical solutions, and explain technical concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
